checks.detail: Package and desktop release authorities are 4.1.0.
Per-monitor DPI and safe window minimums are declared.
The six public workspaces are represented directly; named custom layouts stay in the layout manager.
All six named default profiles are declared.
Docking, floating, splitting, pinning, rearrangement and persistence fields are wired.
Global policy tools moved from the transient dock to Manage.
The left rail is contextual and does not duplicate Game as a global destination.
Physics Monitor is Debug-only and uses a bounded virtualized browser/detail surface.
Project Health uses summary/table/detail instead of dense cards.
Completion is automatic and explicit Ctrl/Cmd+Space is unambiguous.
Declared variable fonts and non-danger audio controls are used.
Core typography, spacing, radius, focus, selection, disabled, warning and error tokens exist.
Search modes, stable command discovery and current context are connected.
Shortcut conflict detection and portable import/export are implemented.
A runtime stable-control inventory assigns test IDs, names and disabled reasons.
Lifecycle flags include Stable/Beta/Experimental/Internal and suppress Internal outside development.
Launcher selection, path validation, Learn Nova_A and template details are visible.
Template guidance is project tutorial content and can be dismissed.
Task Center records progress, cancellation, retry, logs and resource links.
All four build-readiness states are declared.
Full paths and hashes are exposed in a copyable details pane.
